description: This file defines the Normal class within the PhpSpreadsheet calculation library, specifically implementing statistical distributions related to the normal distribution, including functions for probability density, cumulative distribution, and inverse distribution calculations.

classes.name: Normal
classes.description: Provides methods for calculating normal distribution related probabilities, inverse distribution, and related functions.

methods.name: distribution
methods.description: Calculates the probability density function (pdf) or cumulative distribution function (cdf) for the normal distribution, given value, mean, standard deviation, and the type of calculation (cumulative or not).

methods.name: inverse
methods.description: Calculates the inverse of the normal distribution (quantile function) for a given probability, mean, and standard deviation.

methods.name: inverseNcdf
methods.description: Private method implementing an approximation of the inverse normal cumulative distribution function using rational approximation.
